purpose: Reusable input/output contract for task briefs and later tool67; not a deployed software capability or activated skill

required_input.author: Named person; do not infer a client's voice from the agency corpus
required_input.reader_job: One specific reader question or decision
required_input.source_claims: Claim, sourceID, evidence type, date, public-use boundary, exact wording or numerical context
required_input.author_stance: Confirmed opinion, or proposed wording explicitly held for author review
required_input.voice_samples: Owner-selected same-register samples; record the actual sample count and limits
required_input.story_status: Confirmed real event, method/opinion without anecdote, or explicitly illustrative example
required_input.public_boundaries: Omit/anonymize details the author has not cleared
required_input.company_repost_job: Distinct useful company contribution; do not claim the person's memory as the company's
required_input.visual_job: What becomes easier to understand; exact caption revision and data fields
required_input.unresolved_questions: Only inputs that affect truth, stance, scope or publication readiness

required_output: fact, voice, source/rights and format review dispositions
remaining owner questions and next manual step
hard_failures: invented biography, customer result, exact quote, emotion or memory
missing/changed numerical denominator, capture date or uncertainty
wrong author or cross-client source leakage
generated scene represented as a real meeting or customer proof
draft or tool specification described as published/runtime-tested
runtime_status: Task-level contract applied manually to ten concepts; client app build remains67
